rows.statement: Grow Heritage Pure Milk volume and value in core South markets while extending national distribution.
rows.measure: leadership + finance to set: volume/value growth %

rows.statement: Convert loose/unbranded milk buyers and win share from Nandini, Amul and Dodla by making packed daily-fresh milk the default household choice.
rows.measure: penetration + repeat-purchase rate in core markets; marketing to set target %
rows.by_when: marketing to set, aligned to business window

rows.statement: Build fame for 'Pure Doodh Ki Shakti' as the purest everyday milk, and make the unbroken cold chain believable enough to justify choosing packed over loose.
rows.measure: prompted brand awareness + purity/purity-of-cold-chain attribute association, tracked pre/post
rows.by_when: measurement baseline before first burst, then quarterly

rows.audience: Loose/unbranded milk households in core South markets — buy daily from a vendor or dairy, boil and skim at home
rows.believes_now: Loose milk is fresher because they see it that morning; packed milk is processed, older, or thinned. Their trust is in the vendor's face, not a brand. The one thing they cannot check for themselves is whether the milk stayed cold from farm to door — that gap is the opening.

rows.audience: Packed-milk buyers loyal to Nandini, Amul or Dodla in core South markets
rows.believes_now: They already accept packed daily-fresh milk; the co-op or incumbent is a decade-old habit, cheap and everywhere. They see little reason to switch because on purity all packed milk feels the same to them. The lever is meaning, not proof — whose milk makes the morning feel like the family is running ahead.

rows.audience: Young urban parents, nutrition-anxious, in core-market metros and tier-1 towns
rows.believes_now: They read labels and worry about what is added to or missing from a child's milk. They will listen to a purity argument, but what actually moves them is what the milk does for the child — better nourishment, visible strength in the growing years — not the logistics behind it.

rows.audience: Households in national-expansion markets outside the South (new distribution footprint)
rows.believes_now: No prior relationship with Heritage; default to whatever local brand or loose milk they know. Neither pillar lands until basic fame exists — target rank and budget for this segment: marketing to confirm against national rollout pace. If forced to lead, purity travels better than a family-morning cue in an unfamiliar market.

rows.channel: Cold-chain proof film — one continuous clock, farm-to-doorstep, Telugu/Kannada/Tamil cuts, 40s hero + 15s cutdowns
rows.job: Make 'the cold never breaks' believable to loose-milk households — the one thing they can't check for themselves

rows.channel: Regional TV & connected-TV reach buy, South GEC/news day-parts around morning routine
rows.job: Build fame among packed-milk loyalists and loose-milk households who don't yet think of Heritage

rows.channel: Route-level OOH on milk-vendor and dairy-dense streets — steel-vessel-on-flame hero image, #PureDoodhKiShakti
rows.job: Own the daily-fresh street context where loose milk is bought

rows.channel: Vernacular social video — pre-dawn boil, first-coffee ritual, ghee-gold cream band, 9:16 reels
rows.job: Carry the family-morning meaning to young urban parents and packed-milk loyalists

rows.channel: Regional-language creator partnerships — food/mom creators showing the morning ritual, not lab claims
rows.job: Get trusted local voices to carry 'runs ahead' to nutrition-anxious parents
rows.owner: Influencer lead — to be named by marketing

rows.channel: General-trade retail activation — crate branding, fridge stickers, first-time-buyer trial offer at kirana & dairy outlets
rows.job: Turn intent into first pack at the point loose milk is normally bought

rows.channel: Home-delivery / subscription push — onboarding offer, morning-slot sign-up, in-app + doorstep leaflet
rows.job: Convert daily-vendor households to a standing Heritage delivery — the direct substitute for the loose-milk habit

rows.channel: CRM & existing-subscriber advocacy — referral, review prompts, ghee-gold cream photo challenge
rows.job: Get current buyers to carry the message and pull in neighbours
rows.owner: CRM lead — to be named by marketing

rows.channel: National-expansion holding line — purity-led reach in new footprint, phased to rollout pace
rows.job: Build basic fame in non-South markets where neither pillar lands yet; lead on purity, not family-morning
rows.owner: Marketing to confirm scope vs rollout pace

rows.occasion: The pre-dawn boil — milk hitting the vessel and rising to foam before the household wakes. This is where 'the cold never breaks' either lands or doesn't; the household boils the milk precisely because it doesn't trust it.
rows.channels: Cold-chain proof film (lead, TV + cutdowns); Regional TV & CTV reach buy; Route-level OOH on dairy-dense streets; Vernacular social video
rows.hands_over: A household that now believes the purity claim — intent the conversion phase can act on. Also hands the proof film's best-performing cuts to Phase 2 for retargeting.

rows.phase: Phase 2 — Turn belief into the first pack
rows.occasion: The morning milk purchase itself — the moment loose milk is normally bought from vendor or kirana, and the first-coffee ritual that follows. Conversion is placed exactly where the loose-milk habit already happens.
rows.channels: General-trade retail activation (lead — trial offer at kirana & dairy); Home-delivery / subscription push (morning-slot sign-up); OOH continues as reminder; proof film cutdowns retargeted
rows.hands_over: First-time buyers and new subscription starts — a base of week-1 triers the advocacy phase can turn into carriers. Hands trial-conversion data to sales to fix the offer.

rows.occasion: The ghee-gold cream band at the top of the vessel — the visible proof a buyer can show a neighbour. Advocacy is built on the one thing a household can photograph and boast about after they've switched.
rows.channels: CRM & existing-subscriber advocacy (lead — referral + cream-photo challenge); Regional-language creator partnerships; social video sustains reach
rows.hands_over: Referral-driven new buyers and week-4 retention signal — proof the switch holds. Hands sentiment + participation data back to the brand tracker to confirm the pillars are working.

rows.window: Weeks 16 onward — phased to rollout pace
rows.occasion: No owned occasion yet — this is non-South territory where neither the family-morning meaning nor the cold-chain proof has been established. Lead on purity alone; do not import the ritual codes until fame exists.
rows.channels: National-expansion holding line (lead — purity-led reach); proof film if cold-chain claim travels
rows.hands_over: Basic aided awareness in new pin-codes — the precondition for a full Phase 1–3 sequence to run there later.

rows.leading: Claim recall of 'cold never breaks' in weekly tracker dips
rows.lagging: Purity-belief shift vs control at end of flight; loose-milk switching intent
rows.would_tell_us_it_failed: Purity belief flat vs control by week 8 — the film isn't landing the one thing households can't check

rows.leading: 1+ reach build and cost per reach point vs plan, weekly
rows.lagging: Aided awareness lift among loose-milk + packed-milk households at flight end
rows.would_tell_us_it_failed: 3+ reach below target at half-spend, or cost per reach point 20%+ over plan

rows.leading: Trial-pack redemption rate + new-subscription starts, weekly
rows.lagging: Cost per new buyer; week-4 subscription retention
rows.would_tell_us_it_failed: Trial converts but week-4 retention collapses — bought once, back to the vendor

rows.leading: Creator posts delivered + referral participation rate
rows.lagging: Comment sentiment and advocate NPS over the flight
rows.would_tell_us_it_failed: Posts deliver but sentiment neutral/negative, or referrals under 2% of base — voices carrying nothing

rows.who: Brand lead (owner unknown — CMO to name)
rows.speaks_on: Core message, pillar assignment, brand codes, 'Pure Doodh Ki Shakti' line
rows.boundary: No lab-coat, test-tube, factory-purity or clinical white-and-blue imagery; every piece carries FSSAI mark and the mandatory line
rows.decides_changes: Approves any change to messaging or codes

rows.who: Cold-chain / operations lead (owner unknown — ops head to name)
rows.speaks_on: Cold-chain proof claims — the unbroken-clock run, chill-within-hours timing
rows.boundary: May only claim what the cold-chain data verifies; no timing shown that ops cannot stand behind
rows.decides_changes: Signs off proof-claim accuracy before it airs

rows.who: Media / channel lead (owner unknown — head of marketing to name)
rows.speaks_on: Channel roles, phasing, brand/activation split, spend allocation
rows.boundary: Holds the declared split; may not move a proof channel onto an unsourced RTB
rows.decides_changes: Approves reallocation within the plan; escalates split change to brand lead

rows.who: Regional / GT + home-delivery lead (owner unknown — sales head to name)
rows.speaks_on: General trade, home delivery, local-language execution across South India states
rows.boundary: Local idiom kept in Hindi/local tongue, not translated; no claim beyond what the house permits
rows.decides_changes: Approves regional adaptation within house boundaries

rows.who: Social / advocacy owner (owner unknown — marketing to name)
rows.boundary: Same avoid list; must be briefed on live phases and events before posting
rows.decides_changes: None alone — escalates any message change to brand lead

rows.who: Regulatory / compliance (owner unknown — legal to confirm)
rows.speaks_on: FSSAI mandatory mark, dairy claim compliance
rows.boundary: Blocks any claim not legally substantiated
